text: This report explains the results of the review conducted by Parks, Forestry and Recreation of work performed by tree maintenance vendors, which was undertaken in response to City Council's direction to the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation and arising out of the Auditor General's April 26, 2019 Report "Ensuring Value for Money for Tree Maintenance Services". It also provides advice with respect to potential legal action.

City Council on July 28 and 29, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council issue the confidential instructions to staff attached to motion 1 by Councillor John Filion, such instructions to remain confidential, and City Council direct the City Manager to report to the Audit Committee on the outcome. 2. City Council request the Auditor General to report further to the Audit Committee on this matter. 3. City Council receive the report (June 24, 2020) from the City Solicitor and the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation for information and City Council direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 24, 2020) from the City Solicitor and the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation remain confidential. 4.
